what: a 10 x 10 square swept 40 mm along a straight path while turning 90 degrees about the path
method: twisting about the section centre does not change the section area, and the centre moves straight along the path: V = A L = 100 * 40 = 4000. Mid-path the square is turned 45 degrees, so the bbox reaches the corners at 5 sqrt(2) = 7.0711 in x and y.
